codet:
Each non-magnet cell is either "free" (no adjacent magnet) or "stuck". A stuck cell can be entered from a free neighbour but cannot leave, so the reachable set from any cell is the connected component under edges between adjacent non-magnet cells where at least one endpoint is free. The answer is the largest such component (an isolated stuck cell counts as 1). I worked each expected output by hand from this rule.
